facts.fact: Canal212, republishing ANCFCC's catalogue, lists fourteen online services of the land registry agency, including property certificates, cadastral plans, title tracking (Mohafadati), complaints (Chikaya) and map orders, available on ancfcc.gov.ma.

MAR.note: The document states nothing on national ID enrolment.

facts.fact: Canal212 reports that ANCFCC's website lets users request property certificates, cadastral plans and copies of land-register documents online, consult published land notices, and track all formalities on a title through Mohafadati.
